author: cairn
blurb: Search millions of free high-resolution photos on Unsplash. Requires a free API key.

definition.name: Unsplash
definition.description: Search Unsplash's library of free high-resolution photography and get image URLs and attribution.

operations.name: search_photos
operations.toolDefinition: {"name":"search_photos","description":"Search Unsplash for free photos.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"query":{"type":"string","description":"Search terms, e.g. 'mountain sunrise'"},"per_page":{"type":"number","description":"Results per page (max 30)"},"orientation":{"type":"string","enum":["landscape","portrait","squarish"],"description":"Photo orientation filter"}},"required":["query"]}}
